rationale: Pivot from anomaly_gated_histgb (8 train-mode HP iters #1822-1829, ceiling 2/7 wp, W6/W7 both 0/20 across last 20 runs). label_spreading is the first transductive trainer in the 68-trainer registry — at iter #1830 default HP it unlocked W7 (✓ 42.9% WR, +42.7% ann, first W7 pass in 20+ iters), W6 within 6pp WR of the floor (+49.5% ann), and avg_ann +15.9% beats the recent anomaly_gated_histgb HP-sweep band. 12 HPs span graph density (n_neighbors), manifold/prior mix (prior_weight, alpha), and HistGB anchor knobs — wide open for train-mode to sweep.
